title: Optical Code Compiler
payload_rule: The 66 payload symbols are the F12/K12 edge rotations indexed by unordered pairs on 12 labels.
parity_rule: Six parity rows group payload edges by cyclic distance d=1..6; the parity symbol stores the negative class sum in GF3.
special_role: H6 is the antipodal sheet parity row tied to the six distance-6 pairs.
boundary: Finite GF3 incidence compiler only; no quantum code distance proof is claimed.
